runtimeNote: Aegis uses node:sqlite (DatabaseSync), available from Node 22. No third-party runtime dependencies are shipped.
reviewProcedure: At least quarterly (and on every Node security announcement): verify the running Node major is still in security support, confirm no advisory affects node:sqlite / node:crypto / http used by server.js, update reviewedOn, and record the finding in docs/release evidence.
limitation: Offline gate. It cannot detect a newly published CVE; the advisory URL review is a mandatory human/CI-with-network step and is recorded by reviewedOn.
